measurement: total make gpu-run wall time; separate runs from output regression
outlier_rule: No samples removed; one sample per revision, variance not measurable.
notes: Host GPU measurement, not calibrated campus CPU timing.
Both measurements include process startup and model loading.
Model cache was warm: each timing run followed its separate output regression run.
Agent editing and short static checks occurred concurrently; a 0.005-second lifecycle unit check also occurred during the before run.
These single observations cannot establish performance equivalence or a speedup.
